smt-2023-algebra-tiebreaker-01.title: Factor into cyclotomic-type pieces
smt-2023-algebra-tiebreaker-01.body:
The polynomial equals $\frac{x^3-1}{x-1}\cdot\frac{x^{12}-1}{x^4-1}$. So its roots are the roots of $(x^3-1)(x^{12}-1)$ with the roots of $(x-1)(x^4-1)$ removed. These are the $8$ points $e^{i\theta}$ with $\theta=30^\circ,60^\circ,120^\circ,150^\circ,210^\circ,240^\circ,300^\circ,330^\circ$.

Consecutive roots are separated by central angles $30^\circ,60^\circ,30^\circ,60^\circ,\dots$ (four of each). Splitting the polygon into triangles with the origin, the area is $\frac12\left(4\sin30^\circ+4\sin60^\circ\right)=1+\sqrt3$.

**Answer: $1+\sqrt3$**

smt-2023-algebra-tiebreaker-02.title: Degree and coefficients
smt-2023-algebra-tiebreaker-02.body:
If $\deg f=k\ge2$, the left side has degree $k^2$ and the right side $2k$, so $k=2$. (A linear $f$ would make $f(f(x))+f(x)$ linear, but $f(x)^2$ is quadratic.) Write $f=ax^2+bx+c$. Comparing $x^4$ coefficients: $a^3=a^2$, so $a=1$.

Now $f(f(x))=f(x)^2-f(x)$ is divisible by $f(x)$; but $f(f(x))=f(x)^2+bf(x)+c$, so $f(x)\mid c$, forcing $c=0$. Then the equation reads $f^2+bf+f=f^2$, so $b=-1$.

Hence $f(x)=x^2-x$ and $f(3)=6$.

**Answer: 6**

smt-2023-algebra-tiebreaker-03.title: Recentre at the fixed point $2$
smt-2023-algebra-tiebreaker-03.body:
$f(x)-x=(x-2)\left((x-2)^2-\frac12\right)$, so $2$ is a fixed point. Write $x=2+\delta$. Then $f(x)-2=\delta+\delta\left(\delta^2-\frac12\right)=\delta\left(\delta^2+\frac12\right)$.

If $|\delta|>\frac1{\sqrt2}$ then $|f(x)-2|=|\delta|\left(\delta^2+\frac12\right)>|\delta|\cdot c$ with $c>1$, and repeating shows the orbit diverges. If $|\delta|<\frac1{\sqrt2}$ then $|f(x)-2|<|\delta|$ and the orbit stays bounded; at $|\delta|=\frac1{\sqrt2}$, $f(x)-2=\delta$ (a fixed point), also bounded.

So $[a,b]=\left[2-\frac1{\sqrt2},2+\frac1{\sqrt2}\right]$ and $(a-b)^2=\left(\sqrt2\right)^2=2$.

**Answer: 2**
